name: Adamas Trust Inc. 8.00% Series D Fixed-to-Floating Rate Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock
summary: Adamas Trust, Inc. operates as a real estate investment trust (REIT) with a core strategy of acquiring, funding, and overseeing various single-family and multi-family residential assets tied to mortgages across the United States. Its holdings are diverse, encompassing business-purpose loans, residential mortgage-backed securities (both government-sponsored and privately issued), complex multi-family property investments, commercial mortgage-backed securities (CMBS), and a selection of single-family rental homes. Effective September 3, 2025, the firm formally changed its name from New York Mortgage Trust, Inc. to Adamas Trust, Inc. This rebranding reflects a strategic pivot towards a more expansive and multi-faceted investment approach, incorporating greater geographic and product diversity.
